promise: Target India's fiscal deficit at 3.0% of GDP in fiscal 2016-17
description: Jaitley's July 10, 2014 Budget speech set out a consolidation path targeting a 3.0% deficit in fiscal 2016-17; subsequent budgets relaxed that path.
evidence: CAG Report No. 44 of 2017, chapter 1, page 35, reports the 2016-17 Union fiscal deficit at 3.54% of GDP, above the original 3.0% target. This grades the original target, not the later relaxed budget target.
sources: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
